metadata.question: Does the land covered by lava flows increase in the Todoque and El Paraíso areas of La Palma between May 21, 2021 and December 15, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Todoque and El Paraíso, La Palma (Canary Islands, Spain) - approximately 28.6°N, 17.9°W - Dates: May 21, 2021 and December 15, 2021 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for detecting lava flows (thermal anomalies) or land cover changes. Could also use Landsat 8/9. - The Cumbre Vieja volcano erupted in September 2021, so we expect to see lava flows in December but not in May. 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds to get clear views of the surface - Need to detect lava flows - can use NIR/SWIR bands or thermal indices - Lava appears dark in visible but bright in SWIR 3. Logic: - Calculate lava-covered area for both dates - If December area > May area significantly → Answer A (Yes) - If December area ≤ May area → Answer B (No) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failed) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Todoque and El Paraíso area in La Palma la_palma = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.9, 28.6]).buffer(3000) date1_start = '2021-05-15' date1_end = '2021-05-28' date2_start = '2021-12-10' date2_end = '2021-12-20' # 2. Data Acquisition for May 2021 col_may = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \ .filterBounds(la_palma) \ .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \ .map(mask_s2_clouds) size_may = col_may.size().getInfo() print(f"May 2021 Images: {size_may}") if size_may == 0: print("No May data, trying Landsat 8") col_may = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \ .filterBounds(la_palma) \ .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) size_may = col_may.size().getInfo() if size_may == 0: print("C1") exit() # 4. Data Acquisition for December 2021 col_dec = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \ .filterBounds(la_palma) \ .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \ .map(mask_s2_clouds) size_dec = col_dec.size().getInfo() print(f"Dec 2021 Images: {size_dec}") if size_dec == 0: print("No Dec data, trying Landsat 8") col_dec = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \ .filterBounds(la_palma) \ .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) size_dec = col_dec.size().getInfo() if size_dec == 0: print("C1") exit() # 5. Calculate pixel counts count_may = lava_mask_may.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=la_palma, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('B11').getInfo() count_dec = lava_mask_dec.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=la_palma, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('B11').getInfo() print(f"May 2021 lava pixels: {count_may}") print(f"Dec 2021 lava pixels: {count_dec}") # 7. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Todoque and El Paraíso area in La Palma
la_palma = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.9, 28.6]).buffer(3000)

date1_start = '2021-05-15'
date1_end = '2021-05-28'
date2_start = '2021-12-10'
date2_end = '2021-12-20'

# 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2
def mask_s2_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(cloud_mask)

# 3. Data Acquisition for May 2021
col_may = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(la_palma) \
    .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

size_may = col_may.size().getInfo()
print(f"May 2021 Images: {size_may}")

if size_may == 0:
    print("No May data, trying Landsat 8")
    col_may = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(la_palma) \
        .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end)
    size_may = col_may.size().getInfo()
    if size_may == 0:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# 4. Data Acquisition for December 2021
col_dec = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(la_palma) \
    .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

size_dec = col_dec.size().getInfo()
print(f"Dec 2021 Images: {size_dec}")

if size_dec == 0:
    print("No Dec data, trying Landsat 8")
    col_dec = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(la_palma) \
        .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end)
    size_dec = col_dec.size().getInfo()
    if size_dec == 0:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# 5. Process images - detect lava using SWIR (B11, B12) and NIR (B8)
# Lava appears bright in SWIR and dark in visible
img_may = col_may.median()
img_dec = col_dec.median()

# Calculate lava index (SWIR1/NIR ratio - lava has high values)
lava_may = img_may.select('B11').divide(img_may.select('B8'))
lava_dec = img_dec.select('B11').divide(img_dec.select('B8'))

# Threshold for lava detection (lava typically >1.5 in this ratio)
lava_mask_may = lava_may.gt(1.5)
lava_mask_dec = lava_dec.gt(1.5)

# 6. Calculate pixel counts
count_may = lava_mask_may.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=la_palma,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('B11').getInfo()

count_dec = lava_mask_dec.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=la_palma,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('B11').getInfo()

print(f"May 2021 lava pixels: {count_may}")
print(f"Dec 2021 lava pixels: {count_dec}")

# 7. Validation & Final Answer
if count_may is None or count_dec is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif count_may == 0 and count_dec == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif count_dec > count_may:
    increase_pct = ((count_dec - count_may) / max(count_may, 1)) * 100
    print(f"Lava area increased by {increase_pct:.1f}%")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
